transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together to discuss the proposed weekend paint booth campaign to work through our coated bracket backlog. The booth is available, and I have the authority to authorize it, but before I can finalize any operating plan, I need to check in with maintenance and environmental compliance as part of our standard weekend-planning review. So I'd like to hear from both of you — are there any maintenance concerns or environmental compliance issues we need to account for before I sign off on this?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance concern. During my inspection this morning, I measured the booth exhaust filter differential pressure at 2.4 kPa, which is above our 1.5 kPa maintenance limit. The replacement filter is in stores and takes exactly 4 hours to install. I haven't entered the reading in the maintenance system yet, but this needs to be addressed before we run any campaign through that booth.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed my permit review yesterday. The booth may operate for exactly 16 hours during the weekend campaign, but only after two conditions are met: first, a VOC capture test must record at least 95 percent capture, and second, two currently certified coating operators must be assigned to the campaign. I should note that my updated permit note has not yet been attached to the campaign file, so this needs to be formally documented before the plan is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Replace the booth exhaust filter before the campaign begins. The current differential pressure reading of 2.4 kPa exceeds the 1.5 kPa maintenance limit. Filter replacement requires 4 hours of downtime, which must be scheduled before the first shift starts.
Enter the 2.4 kPa exhaust filter differential pressure reading into the maintenance system to formally document the condition and the corrective action.
Attach the updated permit note to the campaign file before the plan is finalized. The permit allows exactly 16 hours of booth operation during the weekend campaign.
Conduct a VOC capture test and verify at least 95 percent capture before the campaign begins.
Assign two currently certified coating operators to the weekend campaign before the plan is finalized.
